body:
The frozen Worker 1 shard proposes four new owners for two equivalent preparations. This concerns unpublished proposals; no maintained owners have been merged or changed.

| Preparation | Proposals | Primary evidence |
|---|---|---|
| CO2-saturated bicarbonate | `NSC-PROP-NBRC_1257_Bicarbonate_Solution` and `CS-PROP-NBRC1321_CO2_BICARBONATE_STOCK` | Both sources specify 8.4 g NaHCO3 plus 100 mL distilled water, CO2 saturation, sealed CO2 bottles and autoclaving. |
| Sulfide from nonahydrate | `NSC-PROP-NBRC_1257_Sulfide_Solution` and `CS-PROP-NBRC1321_SULFIDE_STOCK` | NBRC1257 uses 12 g Na2S·9H2O plus 50 mL water; NBRC1321 uses 24 g plus 100 mL. Both are nominally 1 M, filter sterilized and stored under N2. The batch scales differ by two; the evidence does not establish distinct preparations. |

Primary pages: [NBRC1257](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1257) and [NBRC1321](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1321). Exact captures and payloads are bound in the finding below.

Reconcile each pair to one proposed owner while preserving both source cases, every occurrence, raw labels, original batch scales and receiving-medium amounts. Source numbers alone do not define distinct substances. This does not establish equivalence with generic 84 g/L bicarbonate, neutralized sulfide or 5% sulfide. Preserve added-water amounts without asserting measured final volume; keep generic source-local labels non-resolving. The author/coordinator must select the retained proposal; this issue selects no identifier and authorizes no maintained-owner merge.

The same-source phenanthrene and Metal44 pairs were already reported by the worker and remain separate reconciliation items. Current open-issue deduplication found no tracker for these two cross-source pairs; #1163 concerns the earlier stock-completeness gap.

Evidence under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w01-shard-coordinator-review-v2/`: `finding-003-duplicate-preparations.json`, SHA256 `8395d68231535cb509d7fef4b1d1ad3405498c50fc71d9e9ce259c5219749261`; peer `duplicate-addendum-v1/comparison.json`, SHA256 `1efe59deafe86709301536500ac9a885ab9b2d793144591c1b3ab8c92a573a26`. Frozen proposal manifest SHA256 `eb456ecef3f68b587a2f0281336f88b33679eb8d65a38f842661457ec05866f0`.

Require native validation and independent re-review of the reconciled final payloads. No role, component, mapping-release or whole-record approval follows from this issue.

comments.body:
The two cross-source duplicate pairs now use one canonical proposal each: `CS-PROP-NBRC1321_CO2_BICARBONATE_STOCK` and `CS-PROP-NBRC1321_SULFIDE_STOCK`. The redundant named-lane definitions are retired from active proposals while their original artifacts remain preserved. Both source cases, every occurrence and raw label remain bound to the canonical owner.

Bicarbonate preserves 8.4 g NaHCO3 plus 100 mL distilled water and explicit CO2 saturation in both sources. Sulfide preserves the distinct batch scales: NBRC 1257 uses 12 g Na2S·9H2O plus 50 mL water, whereas NBRC 1321 uses 24 g plus 100 mL. The shared precursor-to-added-water ratio and handling support formulation equivalence; neither source establishes a measured final volume. Generic raw labels remain non-resolving. The separate neutralized and 5% sulfide preparations and generic 84 g/L bicarbonate candidate are not merged.

[Canonical comparison](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/concentration_stocks/captures/crosslane-consolidation-final-v3.json) binds the original consolidation. The sulfide successor in [the atmosphere remediation](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/named_stocks/atmosphere1167/remediation.json) removes N2 from material parts while retaining storage conditions. Same-source phenanthrene and Metal44 duplicates remain tracked under [#1159](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1159); Metal44 is an auxiliary component of the Hutner parent. The [final independent scientific review](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/independent_review/final-188-scientific-review-v1.json) confirms final active-ledger uniqueness and unioned backlinks; the [native full-catalog regression](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/1894d28d94df4e654ebce9752c23a2321aeb21c5/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-01/shard/validation/full-catalog-partonomy-corrected-v3.json) validates the complete combined overlay with zero violations.

No maintained-owner merge or release approval is asserted.
